summary.text: Kristi Mathieson is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 151 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mathieson has served in the Maine House since 2020 and previously worked as a dietitian.

paragraphs.text: Kristi Mathieson lives in Kittery, Maine, and earned an M.S. in human nutrition from the University of New Hampshire in 1989.
Her career experience includes owning the New Hampshire Natural Health Clinic and working as a dietitian.
Mathieson was elected to Maine House District 1 in 2020 and won District 151 in 2022, succeeding John Martin; she won re-election in 2024, defeating Suzanne Johnson.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee and the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee.
Johnson is again her opponent in the 2026 general election.
